## What it does
`test/orders.js` is a small set of order utilities for a shop backend: computing a cart total (`calcTotal`), applying a percentage discount by code (`applyDiscount`), computing average item price (`averageItemPrice`), and formatting a receipt-style string (`formatOrder`).

## Bugs

1. **`calcTotal` off-by-one (critical)** — line 5: `for (let i = 0; i <= items.length; i++)`. This loop runs one iteration too many, so on the last iteration `items[items.length]` is `undefined`, and `undefined.price` throws a `TypeError`. This breaks every function that depends on it (`averageItemPrice`, `formatOrder`). Should be `i < items.length`.

2. **`averageItemPrice` divide-by-zero** — line 20: no guard for `items.length === 0`, so an empty cart returns `NaN`/`Infinity` instead of a sensible value (e.g. `0`).

Once bug #1 is fixed, `calcTotal`/`formatOrder` will work correctly for normal input; the empty-array edge case in #2 would still need an explicit check if that's a case the app expects to handle.
